body.name: Rational recovery atlas and exceptional polynomial
body.construction: Enumerate \(d\) increasingly, then row minors \(J\), kernel pivots \(p\), and denominator candidates \(k\) lexicographically. Each record \(\chi=(d,J,p,k)\) defines a polynomial \(\Delta_{\chi}\) on the full cumulant space and the semialgebraic domain \(\mathcal U_{\chi}=\{\Delta_{\chi}\ne0\}\). Row reduction defines \(f_{\chi}\) and the contraction ratio on \(\mathcal U_{\chi}\); set \(g_{\chi}=\bot\) on its complement. Retain \(\chi\) in \(\mathfrak A^{\mathrm{id}}_{\ell,R}\) exactly when \(\mathcal U_{\chi}\cap\mathcal O_{\ell,R}\ne\varnothing\) and quantified real elimination verifies \(g_{\chi}(\Phi_{\ell,R}(\theta))=\beta(\theta)\) throughout that legal domain. The construction always terminates and may return the empty atlas.
